info.title: Scrub - Open API
info.description: Comprehensive API for geolocalised fraud detection, identity verification, and credit reporting in Nigeria. All responses include a request_id for support tracing.

Bearer.name: Authorization
Bearer.description: JWT access token or API key from Token Management. Format: Bearer <token>

tags.name: consent
tags.description: Public bank-connection consent session (used by the hosted Link UI; no auth)

tags.name: verification
tags.description: Country based identity verification (BVN, NIN, phone)

tags.name: fraud
tags.description: Real-time fraud detection, scoring, and watchlist screening

tags.name: credit
tags.description: Credit scoring and bureau inquiry for Nigerian consumers

post.description: Authenticate with email and password. Returns a JWT access token (and optional refresh token) for dashboard sessions.

get.description: Returns the current user for a valid JWT access token.

post.description: Exchange a refresh token for a new access token.
Upload an image or document and infer whether it is real or AI-generated.

parameters.name: file
parameters.description: Image or document file to analyze

post.description: Analyze an image at a public URL for AI generation signals.
Analyze multiple image URLs in one request.

Start a financial report case. Returns link_url for frontend embed (iframe/redirect). Applicant connects a bank via hosted Link; when done, Scrub POSTs report.ready or report.failed to your Controls webhook URL. Poll GET /report/{case_id} for status: PENDING_CONNECTION, CONNECTED, PROCESSING, REPORT_READY, FAILED, EXPIRED.

get.description: List financial report cases for the authenticated client/user.

Fetch case status. Statuses: PENDING_CONNECTION, CONNECTED, PROCESSING, REPORT_READY, FAILED, EXPIRED. When status is REPORT_READY, includes score, report payload, and optional PDF URL. Prefer webhooks (report.ready / report.failed) for async delivery.

Public session lookup for the hosted Plaid Link UI. Always returns org branding (`display_name`, `brand_name`, `logo_url`) even when the link is expired, used, or invalid. Mounted at the app root (`/c/...`), not under `/api/v1`.

post.description: Creates a provider link token for a valid consent session. Returns branding fields for the Link UI. Mounted at the app root (`/c/...`), not under `/api/v1`.
Validates a Bank Verification Number (BVN) against NIBSS records and returns masked identity attributes. Use during KYC onboarding to confirm a customer's identity before account creation.

400.description: Invalid BVN format or checksum failure

post.description: Validates a National Identification Number (NIN) via NIMC and returns verified identity fields. Recommended for tier-2 KYC and regulatory compliance.
Runs real-time fraud analysis on a transaction using geolocation signals, velocity checks, device fingerprinting, and network graph analysis. Returns a risk score (0–100) and recommended action.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Unique key to safely retry this request without duplicate analysis

get.description: Retrieves the current aggregated fraud risk score for a bank account or wallet. Scores are recalculated when new signals arrive via webhooks or API calls.

404.description: Account not found in Scrub network

post.description: Screens an identity or account against Scrub's consolidated watchlist including reported fraudsters, PEP lists, and sanctioned entities relevant to the Nigerian financial ecosystem.
Evaluates device fingerprint signals (IP, user agent, timezone, emulator detection) to detect account takeover, SIM swap, and multi-accounting patterns common in Nigerian mobile fraud.
Detects abnormal transaction velocity — rapid transfers, burst login attempts, or geographic impossibility — within a configurable time window.
Submits a confirmed fraud case to the Scrub network. Reports are shared (with consent) across participating institutions to improve collective fraud detection.

get.description: Returns paginated fraud alerts for accounts linked to your organization. Alerts are also delivered asynchronously via webhooks.

post.description: Retrieves a consumer credit score (300–850) based on repayment history, credit utilization, and bureau data from CRC Credit Bureau and FirstCentral. Requires explicit customer consent.
Submits a soft or hard credit inquiry to Nigerian credit bureaus. Soft inquiries do not affect the consumer's score; hard inquiries are recorded on the bureau file.

get.description: Returns summarized loan and repayment history for a consumer, including active facilities, closed accounts, and delinquency flags.

detection_data.description: Provider detection payload (filename, status, AI score, media, timing)

country_codes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes for Plaid Link

CreateReportRequest.description: At least one of contact_phone or contact_email is required. subject_id is assigned internally.

link_url.description: Embed this URL in an iframe on the customer platform to open Plaid Link. The hosted UI calls GET /c/{token}/session then POST /c/{token}/link-token.

display_name.description: Name shown in Link UI — client brand_name, else client name, else Scrub

detail.description: Human-readable reason when status is not valid

link_token.description: Provider link token for Plaid Link initialize

display_name.description: Resolved display name used as Plaid client_name

description.example: User tricked into sending money under false pretenses.

is_active.title: Active
is_active.description: Designates whether this user should be treated as active. Unselect this instead of deleting accounts.

inspection_period.title: Inspection period
inspection_period.description: Inspection period in days - 0 indicates immediate
